fuel_consumption.source_quote: Estimated 2004 fuel consumption ~80 million gallons per item7a (implied from collar coverage percentages and item8 disclosures).

instrument_type_details.notes: Fuel hedge collars on jet fuel as cash flow hedges under SFAS 133. Coverage for 2005: Q1=25% (floor $1.37/ceiling $1.60/gal including into-plane); Q2=18.0% (floor $1.19/ceiling $1.39/gal); Q3=13.6% (floor $1.20/ceiling $1.40/gal); Q4=9.2% (floor $1.20/ceiling $1.40/gal). Weighted avg ~16.7% of 2005 estimated fuel consumption. In 2004 expensed $0.3M due to fuel falling below collar floor. At Dec 31, 2004: $0.8M liability for potential collar payments recorded in current accrued liabilities. Effective portion of change in FV recorded in OCI until fuel consumed; reclassified to income as fuel expense offset.

throughput.source_quote: Aircraft fuel and oil and associated taxes increased $27.3 million, or 33.6%, from 2003 to $108.4 million in 2004. Into-plane fuel prices increased 33.1% in 2004, averaging $1.35 per gallon in 2004 versus $1.01 per gallon in 2003. Fuel consumption increased 0.5% in 2004. [Derived: $108.4M / $1.35 = 80.3M gallons]

warnings: Switched from call options (2001-2002) to zero-cost collars from 2004 onward.
